_comment: MCP capability gate policy (Slice 11a; action-anchored key added 3d F2). guard_check_mcp denies un-allowlisted destructive/egress MCP tools by default. Add the tools this project needs. Two honored allow shapes: an exact 'mcp__server__action' entry, or an action-anchored, server-agnostic 'mcp__*__action' key that admits that action on ANY server (server-rename-proof — the connected GitHub MCP server has been seen as both 'github' and 'claude_ai_Github_MCP'). A full-server wildcard 'mcp__server__*' (and 'mcp__*__*') is REJECTED — it would admit every tool on a server, so it no longer permits anything; prefer exact or action-anchored keys. classOverride reclassifies a single tool (e.g. {"mcp__x__export_report": "read"}). The action-anchored key is a per-action trust decision, not authentication of the tool; real egress is the platform boundary's job. Control-plane: edit only via human maintenance.
